objective_conditions: Volcengine Ark is both a first-party platform for Doubao/Seed models and a serving platform for third-party/open models.

A real Ark /models receipt on 2026-08-11 returned 129 models through the current account, including Doubao/Seed and third-party/open model families such as DeepSeek. This is current L5 evidence for the platform-aggregation condition, not a permanent catalog.
Model capability and platform behavior can change independently of plugin releases.
AstrBot already owns provider lifecycle, routing/fallback/retry, provider-source/model-card management, metadata display, and Dashboard rendering.
AstrBot capability icons are incomplete feedback, not a complete model-capability truth table.
Interaction is not judgment: enough information to translate, send, receive, or display a request does not imply enough information or authority to make a permanent model-capability decision.
Different AstrBot provider types can have materially different Dashboard layouts and user paths.
Both plugin-owned Volcengine Ark and Agent Plan providers currently register as AstrBot chat_completion providers; Agent Plan is not an agent_runner card.
End-to-end modality availability depends on the complete QQ/NapCat/AstrBot/adapter/provider/model path, not only model capability.
A raw provider API fixture is not equivalent to a QQ media event. Raw tests are useful for downstream protocol attribution but cannot by themselves prove or disprove QQ product compatibility.

Historical QQ-oriented audio/video validation remains evidence until a changed dependency invalidates its conditions. Not re-running an unchanged product path is not equivalent to never having validated it.
A real AstrBot v4.27.2 production Dashboard has been built and started with this plugin loaded; browser login and the Provider page have been reached successfully.

The first fine provider-card Playwright matrix encoded unstable harness assumptions including welcome overlays, display labels, fixed source IDs, and selector structure. Its failures did not by themselves implicate plugin runtime logic.
A flow diagram does not prove reachability: each arrow requires a concrete host/plugin/upstream interface or a minimal existence experiment.

With the repository ordinary Ark secret, raw ordinary Ark /models and raw ordinary Ark text both succeeded, and the same /models and text paths through ProviderVolcengineArk also succeeded in the same run.

A Pillow-generated PNG sent as the same bytes through a raw Ark image_url data URI and through ProviderVolcengineArk using AstrBot's local-path MediaResolver both received HTTP 200 in the observed run. This is current raw-vs-plugin image-path parity, not a permanent capability claim.

The same ordinary Ark secret was rejected by both a minimal raw Agent Plan text request and ProviderVolcengineAgentPlan. Therefore that run is evidence of an Agent Plan credential/account prerequisite, not evidence of a plugin-path defect or permanent model incapability.
expected_outcomes: Expose implemented Volcengine request transport paths without converting them into permanent model-capability claims.
Preserve current upstream feedback without persisting stale plugin feedback as truth.
Keep provider-specific UI and configuration isolated from foreign providers.
Preserve explicit user intent during migration.
Distinguish local input-transport failure from upstream/model rejection without owning AstrBot routing decisions.
Use evidence levels so code, host integration, UI observation, real API behavior, historical validation, and complete QQ user paths are not conflated.
Use impact-based regression scope so unchanged historical media paths are not repeatedly re-proven by non-equivalent fixtures.
Keep project state, test history, knowledge boundaries, and AI entry points explicit enough that a future maintainer can reconstruct why the current strategy exists.

active_validation_frontier.reason: Changed capability-feedback, migration, Dashboard and evidence layers have dedicated validation. Audio/video product paths are historical regression assets whose full QQ-equivalent rerun is impact-triggered rather than replaced by raw fixtures.
